title: How to Order a Replacement Credit Card (Internal)
summary: Internal procedure for ordering a replacement credit card: verify identity, look up the account, confirm primary/alternate shipping address with unit/suite, collect a single replacement reason (fraud_suspected, lost, stolen, damaged, expired, other), check eligibility, and select standard (7–10 business days, $0) or expedited (2–3 business days; tier fees: $15 entry, $10 mid, $0 Gold/Platinum/Diamond Elite). It then unlocks and calls tool order_replacement_credit_card_7291 with required fields, cancels the old card automatically, and communicates email notifications and delivery windows.
faqs: What identity verification and account/address checks are required before ordering a replacement credit card?
